text:
margot: Quick ask — we need a one‑pager for enterprise prospects that bundles security + SLAs + deployment modes. Purpose: field enablement (AEs + SEs) + webinar CTA + inbound routing rules. Who can own the copy and the benchmark narrative?
samir: I can take first draft. Need clarity on audience (platform/security/product) and which benchmark numbers to call out. Also do we want a small visual comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private?
tara: Audience should be Platform/InfoSec + procurement. Must lead with data controls: VPC, KMS/HSM, audit logs, SOC/ISO creds. Yes to a simple visual tradeoff (latency / cost / isolation). Keep phrasing: "Same API across hosted, dedicated, private".
liam: I can pull benchmark numbers from infra. Suggest chart with p50/p95 latency and $/1000 tokens cost by mode + SLA bullet per tier. ETA: EOD tomorrow for raw numbers.
margot: Perfect. For benchmark narrative, avoid vendor model name callouts — use "curated open models" and "quantized variants". Messaging hooks: predictable inference economics, unified runtime, SLA-backed latency targets, data residency + key management.
samir: Draft outline I plan to write: 1) Hero & value props (3 bullets) 2) Security & compliance highlights 3) SLA + performance snapshot (chart + 2 bullets) 4) Deployment decision flow (when to pick Dedicated vs Private) 5) CTA & routing for AE/webinar signup.
liam: Raw numbers preview (will refine): Hosted (small open model) p95 ~120ms, cost $0.09/1k tokens; Dedicated (reserved 8xA100 pool) p95 ~200ms, cost $0.06/1k tokens; Private on-prem varies — call out range and note "depends on infra". I'll attach CSV in thread later.
tara: Add a compliance callout: "Optional on-prem package + audit logs + integration with customer KMS/HSM" and a one-liner about artifact retention & auditability. Also include example SLA bullets: 99.95% uptime (Dedicated), 99.9% (Hosted).
margot: Nice. For inbound routing, propose: MQLs with >50k tokens/month or specific security tags route to enterprise SDR queue. Webinar RSVPs get routed to AE for follow-up after attendance.
samir: I'll produce draft copy and visual mock by Fri. I'll include two micro-headlines to A/B test in the webinar email.
liam: Adding note — benchmark narrative should call out methodology briefly: workload mix (chat vs completion), seq length median, batching used. Keeps claims defensible.
doc-bot: doc created: https://redwood.app/docs/onepagers/enterprise-deploy-brief-draft-v1 (owner: samir)
margot: Sweet. Owners: Samir (copy + visual), Liam (benchmarks), Tara (compliance review). I'll schedule a 30m review on Monday and draft webinar announcement once we lock the one‑pager. Thanks all :thumbsup:
samir: on it, will ping when draft is uploaded.
